questions.stem:
$\dfrac{x^2}{\sqrt{x^2 - c^2}} = \dfrac{c^2}{\sqrt{x^2 - c^2}} + 39$

In the given equation, $c$ is a positive constant. Which of the following is one of the solutions to the given equation?

The graph models the number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of every six-month period, where $x$ is the number of six-month periods since the end of January $1995$ and $0 \le x \le 4$. Which statement is the best interpretation of the point $(1, 600)$ in this context?

options.A: The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of the first six-month period was 600.
options.B: The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers increased every six months by 600 subscribers.
options.C: The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of January 1995 was 600.
options.D: The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of January 1996 was 600.

figures.alt: Graph titled Online Newsletter Subscribers. Horizontal axis x, labelled Time (six-month periods), marked 1, 2, 3, 4. Vertical axis labelled Number of subscribers, marked 400, 800, 1,200. A curve rises steeply from about 200 at x = 0, passes through a marked dot at (1, 600), and stops near x = 1.6 at about 1,200. Gridlines on both axes.

questions.stem:
$d = 16t$

The given equation represents the distance $d$, in inches, where $t$ represents the number of seconds since an object started moving. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 16 in this context?

options.A: The object moved a total of 16 inches.
options.B: The object moved a total of $16t$ inches.
options.C: The object is moving at a rate of 16 inches per second.
options.D: The object is moving at a rate of $\frac{1}{16}$ inches per second.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \text{Year} & \text{Subscriptions sold}\\\hline 2012 & 5{,}600\\\hline 2013 & 5{,}880\\\hline\end{array}$$

The manager of an online news service received the report above on the number of subscriptions sold by the service. The manager estimated that the percent increase from 2012 to 2013 would be double the percent increase from 2013 to 2014. How many subscriptions did the manager expect would be sold in 2014?

The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, $x$ and $y$, for the 7 data points in data set W. A line of best fit for data set W is also shown. This line can be represented by an equation in the form $y = a + cx$, where $a$ and $c$ are constants. Data set V consists of all the data points in data set W as well as the point $(14, 8)$. A line of best fit for data set V can be represented by the equation $y = j + kx$, where $j$ and $k$ are constants. Assuming the lines of best fit are calculated the same way, which of the following statements must be true?

I. $a > j$
II. $c > k$

figures.alt: Scatterplot with x-axis 0 to 14 and y-axis 0 to 14 (grid lines each 1 unit, labels every 2). Seven dots, read by eye, approx. (2,4), (4.5,6), (5.5,10), (6.5,6), (7,8.5), (9.5,10), (12.5,13.5). A solid straight line of best fit rises from about (0, 2.6) to the upper right, ending near (15, 15.5).
